title: The Ospreys Cry
lines: "Guan-guan," cry the ospreys,
On the islet in the river.
The lovely, modest, virtuous young lady —
A fit match for a gentleman.
Short and long the water plants grow,
To left and right we pluck them.
The lovely, modest, virtuous young lady —
In waking and sleeping he sought her.
He sought her but could not find her.
Waking and sleeping he thought of her.
Long he thought; oh, long and anxiously.
Tossing and turning on his bed.
Short and long the water plants grow,
To left and right we gather them.
The lovely, modest, virtuous young lady —
Guitar and zither, let us welcome her as a friend.
Short and long the water plants grow,
To left and right we pick and choose them.
The lovely, modest, virtuous young lady —
Bells and drums, let us bring joy to her.
